# Tenancy & accounts blocks

<!-- Generated by scripts/build-skill-references.ts from the block manifests. -->

The Tenancy & accounts blocks of this version of better-supabase, from the block manifests. Install one with `npx better-supabase add <block>`; the docs page of each block has the method signatures. Entity names are the defaults; an app can rename them under `blocks.<name>.names`.

## memberships

Memberships with roles, member_organization_ids() and has_organization_role() for RLS policies, and membership_claims() for the access token hook. Adopt an existing memberships table through blocks.memberships.

- Title: Tenant memberships and permission helper
- Docs: https://bettersupabase.com/docs/blocks/memberships
- Client: `better-supabase/blocks/memberships`
- Modes: `managed`, `custom`
- Requires: `updated-at`
- Works with: `permissions`, `invitations`, `organizations`
- Entities: `organization`

## invitations

invite_member(tenant, email, role) returns a single-use token whose hash is stored; accept_invitation(token) checks the signed-in user's confirmed email and, again, the inviter's authority. Roles follow the access model; a null tenant invites to a platform role, stored in platform_invitations.

- Title: Invitations
- Docs: https://bettersupabase.com/docs/blocks/organizations
- Modes: `managed`, `custom`
- Requires: `memberships`, `permissions`, `updated-at`
- Works with: `organizations`, `profiles`, `teams`
- Events: `invitation.accepted`, `invitation.created`, `invitation.declined`, `invitation.resent`, `invitation.revoked`, `invitation.updated`, `organization.member_added`

## reserved-slugs

A slug format and length check and a list of reserved words (admin, api, www, ...), enforced by a trigger.

- Title: Reserved slugs
- Docs: https://bettersupabase.com/docs/blocks/reserved-slugs
- Modes: `managed`

## organizations

create_organization(attrs) with slug rules and an after-create hook, a deferred owner check, an assignment ceiling, and member functions (role change, remove, leave, transfer ownership) on the access contract.

- Title: Organizations
- Docs: https://bettersupabase.com/docs/blocks/organizations
- Client: `organizationsBlock` from `better-supabase/blocks/organizations`
- Modes: `managed`, `custom`
- Requires: `memberships`, `permissions`, `seeds`, `updated-at`
- Works with: `audit`, `billing`, `data-lifecycle`, `entitlements`, `invitations`, `reserved-slugs`, `imports`
- Events (`OrganizationsEvents`): `organization.created`, `organization.deleted`, `organization.member_left`, `organization.member_removed`, `organization.member_resumed`, `organization.member_suspended`, `organization.ownership_transferred`, `organization.role_changed`, `organization.switched`, `organization.updated`

## profiles

A profile per user, created on sign-up from auth metadata with a unique username, an email mirror, column-level update grants and a guard on columns the service owns.

- Title: Profiles
- Docs: https://bettersupabase.com/docs/blocks/profiles
- Client: `profilesBlock` from `better-supabase/blocks/profiles`
- Modes: `managed`, `custom`
- Works with: `memberships`, `teams`

## settings

Per-user, per-organization and platform-wide settings as key-value jsonb rows. Users read and write their own; organization settings check settings.read and settings.update; platform settings check a platform permission per key. Keys with a JSON Schema in options.schemas get a pg_jsonschema check.

- Title: Settings
- Docs: https://bettersupabase.com/docs/blocks/settings
- Client: `settingsBlock` from `better-supabase/blocks/settings`
- Modes: `managed`, `custom`
- Requires: `memberships`, `permissions`
- Works with: `jsonb-schemas`
- Events (`SettingsEvents`): `organization_setting.reset`, `organization_setting.updated`, `platform_setting.reset`, `platform_setting.updated`

## teams

Tenant teams and their members. Inbox assignment uses these rows instead of its own team tables.

- Title: Teams
- Docs: https://bettersupabase.com/docs/blocks/teams
- Client: `teamsBlock` from `better-supabase/blocks/teams`
- Modes: `managed`, `custom`
- Requires: `memberships`, `permissions`
- Works with: `inbox`, `outbox`, `audit`, `employees`
- Entities: `team`
- Tables: `teams`
- Permission keys: `teams.manage`, `teams.read`
- Events (`TeamsEvents`): `team.archived`, `team.created`, `team.purged`, `team.updated`, `team_member.added`, `team_member.deleted`

## domains

Hostnames an organization serves its app on: custom domains verified by a DNS TXT record, subdomains of the platform domain, one primary per organization, and resolve_hostname() for the proxy.

- Title: Custom domains
- Docs: https://bettersupabase.com/docs/blocks/domains
- Client: `domainsBlock` from `better-supabase/blocks/domains`
- Modes: `managed`, `custom`
- Requires: `memberships`, `permissions`
- Works with: `reserved-slugs`
- Events (`DomainsEvents`): `hostname.added`, `hostname.deleted`, `hostname.primary_changed`, `hostname.verified`

## legal-entities

Several legal entities inside one organization, each with its VAT and chamber numbers, bank account, logo and fiscal settings and one default per organization. Settings resolve from the legal entity to the organization to the code default, and options.on adds a nullable legal_entity_id to invoices, quotes, orders, numbering, accounting, inventory locations and settings; null means the default entity.

- Title: Legal entities
- Docs: https://bettersupabase.com/docs/blocks/legal-entities
- Client: `legalEntitiesBlock` from `better-supabase/blocks/legal-entities`
- Modes: `managed`, `custom`
- Requires: `memberships`, `permissions`, `settings`
- Works with: `attachments`, `invoices`, `quotes`, `orders`, `numbering`, `accounting`, `inventory`, `outbox`, `audit`, `custom-fields`
- Entities: `legal_entity`, `legal_entity_setting`
- Tables: `legal_entities`, `legal_entity_settings`
- Permission keys: `legal_entities.read`, `legal_entities.manage`
- Events (`LegalEntitiesEvents`): `legal_entity.created`, `legal_entity.updated`

## document-templates

Templates for invoices, credit notes, quotes, orders, dunning letters, delivery notes and statements per legal entity and language, reusable text blocks, one versioned variable contract per document type, and render_document, which returns the variables, the chosen template and its texts. An issued invoice or credit note is frozen with the template version it used, so rendering it again never changes it.

- Title: Document templates
- Docs: https://bettersupabase.com/docs/blocks/document-templates
- Client: `documentTemplatesBlock` from `better-supabase/blocks/document-templates`
- Modes: `managed`, `custom`
- Requires: `memberships`, `permissions`, `legal-entities`
- Works with: `invoices`, `inventory`, `catalog`, `quotes`, `orders`, `shipments`, `contacts`, `tax`, `imports`, `outbox`, `audit`
- Entities: `document_template`, `document_text_block`, `document_snapshot`
- Tables: `document_templates`, `document_text_blocks`, `rendered_documents`
- Permission keys: `document_templates.read`, `document_templates.manage`
- Events (`DocumentTemplatesEvents`): `document_snapshot.created`, `document_template.created`, `document_template.updated`, `document_text_block.created`, `document_text_block.updated`

## seeds

seed_tenant_defaults(tenant, variants, locale) applies the defaults every installed block declares, in install order. The organizations block calls it when an organization is created.

- Title: Seeds
- Docs: https://bettersupabase.com/docs/blocks/sql
- Modes: `managed`
